login.title: Shiga Abokin Tashar Tashar
login.welcome: Barka da dawowa! Shiga don sarrafa jagoranku.
login.heroTitle: Haɓaka kasuwancin ku na ƙasa tare da kowane jagorar da kuka kawo
login.heroIntro: Portal ɗaya don yin rijistar abokan ciniki tare da magina, kiyaye ƙimar jagororin ku kuma bi su har zuwa yin rajista.

register.title: Yi rijistar jagora a cikin daƙiƙa guda
register.text: Ƙaddamar da abokin cinikin ku da aikin da suke sha'awar.

protect.title: Kwafin kariya
protect.text: Jagorar ku ta kasance taku don lokacin kariya, don haka babu wanda zai iya da'awar abokin ciniki iri ɗaya.

track.title: Bi kowane mataki
track.text: Dubi matsayin kowane jagora da cikakken tarihinsa, daga lamba ta farko zuwa yin ajiya.

handover.title: Kiredit a booking
handover.text: Lokacin littattafan abokin ciniki, ana mika jagorar ga magini tare da yin rikodin ku azaman abokin tarayya.

login.secure: Amintaccen shiga - bayanan abokan cinikin ku suna zama masu sirri

signup.title: Rajistan Abokan Tashar Tashar
signup.intro: Ƙirƙiri asusun ku don fara yin rijista da sarrafa naku jagora.
